As Facebook (FB) Market Value Declined, Holder Polen Capital Management Trimmed Its Position; Highland Capital Management LP Holding in Apple (AAPL) Has Cut as Shares Rose
June 6, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
James Dondero decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 19.4% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Highland Capital Management Lp sold 6,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by James Dondero held 27,000 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.53M, down from 33,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Highland Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $950.15 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.77% or $1.48 during the last trading session, reaching $193.31. About 19.54M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
